title: FHFA House Price Index — Quarterly Index with Monthly Tables (June 2027 and 2027Q2), 9:00 a.m. ET
source: FHFA: two FHFA primaries fetched direct 2026-09-06 by this session, independently of the sweep that proposed this id. (1) fhfa.gov/data/hpi (HTTP 200, 89,663 bytes) — its "2027 HPI Release Dates" table reads "Tuesday, August 31 | Quarterly Index (with Monthly Tables) | June 2027 and 2027Q2", the eighth of twelve dated 2027 rows (Jan 26 -> Dec 28, every one a last Tuesday, quarterly editions on Feb 23 / May 25 / Aug 31 / Nov 30). (2) The published 2026Q2 report (HTTP 200, 1,522,949 bytes, released 2026-08-25), whose "FHFA HPI Release Dates for 2027" appendix page carries the identical row above the statement: "Public FHFA HPI(R) releases occur at 9AM ET and include a press release, tables, figures, and associated data" — a published document, not a second reading of the same web table, and the source of the 9:00 a.m. ET time. Promoted estimate -> confirmed on the precedent construction-spending-2026-12-01, new-home-sales-2026-11-25, fhfa-hpi-2026-11-24, fhfa-hpi-2026-12-29, fhfa-hpi-2027-01-26 and fhfa-hpi-2027-02-23 set: the no-self-confirm limit binds the DISCOVERING sweep (consumer-confidence-2027-08-31), not this event's own independent second look. 2027-08-31 is the last Tuesday of August 2027 and also its last calendar day, so the row is internally consistent with the rule the other eleven follow. notes: PROPOSED by the consumer-confidence-2027-08-31 initial-research sweep (2026-09-06) and researched the same day; the proposal file is now shadowed by this canonical one. INITIAL RESEARCH 2026-09-06 (docs/research/events/fhfa-hpi-2027-08-31.md) CORRECTS A SIBLING AND THEN BREAKS ITS OWN CORRECTION. fhfa-hpi-2027-02-23 called the February print "the only FHFA session a year with no Fed on it". Measured here across all 56 posted FOMC meeting pairs and the 271-row FHFA archive, that is WRONG BY EXACTLY ONE: all six August releases since 2021 (2021-08-31, 2022-08-30, 2023-08-29, 2024-08-27, 2025-08-26, 2026-08-25) sit at EXACTLY 21 days from the nearest FOMC day and 0 of 6 fall in a blackout -- identical to February's 6 of 6 and 0 of 6, and 21 is the MAXIMUM of that distance across all 68 releases (median 13, min 0). The mechanism is the same and it is broader than the sibling knew: lastTue(M) + 21 days == thirdTue(M+1) is an identity holding for ALL TWELVE MONTHS with zero exceptions 1990-2060, so what actually selects February and August is which months the FOMC opens on a third Tuesday -- March 7 of 7, September 6 of 7. AND 2027 IS THE ONE YEAR THE TWIN BREAKS: the Board posted September 2027 as Sep 14-15, the SECOND Tuesday, the only non-third-Tuesday September in seven postings. That drops this instance from the structural 21 days to 14. Derived from the Board's own verbatim blackout rule (fomc-blackout-period-calendar.pdf, HTTP 200, 98,013 bytes, "if the Committee meeting starts on a Tuesday, the blackout period will begin at the start of the Saturday that falls ten days earlier"), the September 2027 blackout opens Saturday 2027-09-04 -- 2027-08-31 clears it by FOUR DAYS, the narrowest clearance any August release has had. That blackout is proposed in this PR as proposals/fomc-blackout-start-2027-09-04.from-fhfa-hpi-2027-08-31.json. ALSO MEASURED, and it kills the proposer's stacking claim at daily resolution: 2027-08-31 is simultaneously the last Tuesday, the last calendar day and the last trading session of August, and NONE of that separates -- month-final sessions (n=69) are null on all four metrics (VIX p=0.3749, SPX |c2c| p=0.9998, VIX9D/VIX p=0.1223, VIX range p=0.8658) and FHFA releases that are ALSO month-final (n=11, of which 2021-08-31 is the one prior instance of this exact configuration) are null too (p=0.92 / 0.68 / 0.42 / 0.80). August release days are null on everything (p=0.22 / 0.49 / 0.52 / 0.40) while ALL August sessions are the quietest of the year (VIX close 16.26 vs 18.23, p=0.0000; VIX range 1.285 vs 1.610, p=0.0117) -- the exact MIRROR of the February ledger's volatile-month trap, same control logic, opposite sign: the month owns the effect and the release adds nothing. Content: June m/m is the FOURTH reference month refuted (15/15 positive since 2012, 30/36 all-time, p=0.3585) and 2027Q2 is the quarterly analogue (Q2 15/15 since 2012, p=1.0000, the perfectly indistinguishable quarter).
